# LOOK Programming Language

> LOOK is a modern, all-in-one scripting language for the web — a single static binary with minimal external runtime dependencies. It embeds MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite, WebSocket, Server-Sent Events, and an SMTP/IMAP mail server, so a complete web application runs from one file with no framework.

LOOK is built and maintained by Codlook. The language ships as one binary for Linux and Windows. You write routes, database queries, templates and background jobs directly; the runtime handles concurrency, connection pooling and hot reload. The default engine is a bytecode VM, with a tree-walk interpreter as a fallback.

## Documentation
- [Home](https://look.codlook.com/index.html): What LOOK is, the language at a glance, and how to get started in seconds.
- [Documentation](https://look.codlook.com/docs.html): The full reference — syntax, types, routing, database, templates, sessions, real-time (WebSocket/SSE), background jobs, deployment, environment variables, and every built-in function.
- [Packages](https://look.codlook.com/packages.html): The modules that ship inside the language, plus installable modules (`lk module install`) and packages (`lk install`) from the ecosystem.
- [Error Reference](https://look.codlook.com/errors.html): Every runtime and parse error with its cause, the fix, and a wrong→right code example.

## Ecosystem
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/codlook/look): Source code, releases and issue tracker.
- [Latest release](https://github.com/codlook/look/releases/latest): Prebuilt binaries for Linux, Windows and Plesk, plus the Docker image.
- [VS Code extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=codlook.look-lang): Syntax highlighting, IntelliSense and live error checking.

## About
- [Codlook](https://codlook.com): The software studio behind LOOK.
